title: isodon rugosus
intro: Isodon rugosus, commonly known as Chinese rubberweed or Isodon, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Isodon rugosus include pain relief, fever reduction, and wound healing, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and diterpenoids. These bioactive constituents are responsible for the plant's medicinal properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
